{"CommandLine":"python3 -c '
import json, urllib.request, subprocess, shutil, os
from pathlib import Path

# Get starred repos
url = "https://api.github.com/users/adityashirsatrao007/starred"
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
        repos = json.loads(response.read().decode())
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error fetching repos: {e}")
    repos = []

target_dir = Path("/home/aditya/Desktop/Projects/MEMORY/.agents/skills")
tmp_dir = Path("/tmp/starred_repos")
tmp_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

for r in repos:
    name = r["full_name"]
    clone_url = r["clone_url"]
    folder_name = r["name"]
    repo_tmp = tmp_dir / folder_name
    print(f"Cloning {name}...")
    if repo_tmp.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(repo_tmp)
    
    try:
        subprocess.run(["git", "clone", "--depth", "1", clone_url, str(repo_tmp)], check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Failed to clone {name}: {e}")
        continue
    
    # Find all SKILL.md files
    skills = list(repo_tmp.rglob("SKILL.md"))
    if skills:
        for skill_file in skills:
            skill_src_dir = skill_file.parent
            skill_name = skill_src_dir.name
            if skill_name == folder_name or not skill_name:
                skill_name = f"{folder_name}-main"
            
            # Avoid conflict with existing names
            dest = target_dir / skill_name
            if dest.exists():
                print(f"Skill {skill_name} already exists. Appending repo prefix...")
                dest = target_dir / f"{folder_name}-{skill_name}"
            
            print(f"-> Installing skill: {skill_name} from {name}")
            shutil.copytree(skill_src_dir, dest, dirs_exist_ok=True)
    else:
        # If no SKILL.md, but contains markdown documentation we might use, create a wrapper skill
        readme = repo_tmp / "README.md"
        agents_md = repo_tmp / "AGENTS.md"
        docs_file = agents_md if agents_md.exists() else (readme if readme.exists() else None)
        if docs_file:
            skill_name = folder_name
            dest = target_dir / skill_name
            if not dest.exists():
                dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                # Create a simple SKILL.md wrapping the README or AGENTS file
                skill_content = f"---\nname: {skill_name}\ndescription: Documentation and guidelines for {name}\n---\n\n"
                skill_content += docs_file.read_text(errors="ignore")
                (dest / "SKILL.md").write_text(skill_content)
                print(f"-> Created wrapper skill for {name}")
            else:
                print(f"-> Skill {skill_name} already exists, skipping wrapper.")
